parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: domain-name
parameters.explanation: 设备的域名，用于网络中的域名解析。

parameters.name: authentication-order
parameters.explanation: 认证顺序，指定认证方法。

set system radius-server 10.6.55.55 port.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器的IP地址、端口和共享密钥。

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: 与RADIUS服务器通信的共享密钥。

set system radius-server 10.6.55.55 acco.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器的计费端口。

set system accounting destination radius.template: set system accounting destination radius server [parameter1] secret [parameter2]
set system accounting destination radius.command: set system accounting destination radius server 10.6.55.55 secret "051B1C224D0A324E1D"
set system accounting destination radius.explanation: 配置系统计费信息发送到指定的RADIUS服务器。

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: 与RADIUS服务器通信的共享密钥。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet network [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet network 10.10.10.0/24
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的IPv4网络地址及子网掩码。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet range user-range low [parameter2]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet range user-range low 10.10.10.3
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的用户范围下限。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet range user-range high [parameter2]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet range user-range high 10.10.10.100
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的用户范围上限。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet6 prefix [parameter2]/[parameter3] prefix-length [parameter4]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet6 prefix 2001:db8:3::/64 prefix-length 64
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置地址分配池的IPv6前缀及前缀长度。

set access profile radius-access authent.command: set access profile radius-access authentication-order radius
set access profile radius-access authent.explanation: 配置访问配置文件的认证顺序。

parameters.name: authentication-order
parameters.explanation: 认证顺序，指定认证方法。

set access profile radius-access client.template: set access profile [parameter1] client radius-server [parameter2] secret [parameter3]
set access profile radius-access client.command: set access profile radius-access client radius-server 10.6.55.55 secret "051B1C224D0A324E1D"
set access profile radius-access client.explanation: 配置访问配置文件的RADIUS客户端信息。

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: 与RADIUS服务器通信的共享密钥。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
